mutations.because: V3's split is worthless if a thread that appears in two workflows is pinned on the first one that happened to match. Taking matches[0] on length >= 1 turns an unattributed collision into a false UI (or API) count, which is exactly the guess the fail-closed rule exists to refuse. Caught by the two-logs test asserting unattributed, not UI.
command: text present in two logs is unattributed, never the first match

mutations.because: The job log stores the model's response JSON-escaped (\n, \", \u2011). Matching the thread's plain suggestion against the raw log misses every quote, every newline, and the non-breaking hyphen PR-Agent actually writes, so a real API thread looks unattributed. Caught by the escape test, whose log is the escaped form of the thread text.
